text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While stopping by the dance studio to
pick up
something I forgot, I see an
enthralled Haru Urara
practicing by
herself.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Aaand, all done! Ah, this really takes
me back!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, when I was small, I used to sing
and dance
in my family's workshed.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, the memory suddenly popped
into my
head while I was dancing! My
family made me a
microphone out of a
stick and everything!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And, and! The day I started this school,
they
made me a huge banner saying
"You can do it!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
They even promised they'd bring it to
my concert.
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, I gotta practice real hard! I can't let
them
down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! I should get back to dancing
then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara fervently begins practicing
again. She
occasionally gets the lyrics
wrong, but she's got
the spirit, and it's a
good performance.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, what do you think? You think
they'll like it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I thought so! I was worried there for
second.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But then I pictured that "You can do it!"
sign and I
knew I had to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm really gonna sing and dance my heart
out for
the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She jubilantly continues to practice and
later
gives a truly heartfelt live
performance.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! Sometimes I do forget the
words.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But if I memorize all of them, it'll be a

super-duper great show!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And then I'll really wow the audience! Heehee!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna do my best to
memorize them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She nails the lyrics and vocal inflections,
and the
live performance turns out
absolutely wonderful.
